name: travel-planner-web
description: 근거 기반(grounded) 여행 일정을 만드는 Discord 봇 + 웹앱 (Node.js)

scripts.bot:install: mkdir -p ~/Library/LaunchAgents && npm run bot:launchd:plist > ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.travel-planner.discord-bot.plist && (launchctl unload ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.travel-planner.discord-bot.plist 2>/dev/null || true) && launchctl load ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.travel-planner.discord-bot.plist && npm run bot:start
scripts.bot:start: launchctl start com.travel-planner.discord-bot && npm run bot:status || echo "Travel Planner Discord bot LaunchAgent is not loaded. Run npm run bot:install after .env is ready."
scripts.bot:restart: (launchctl stop com.travel-planner.discord-bot 2>/dev/null || true) && npm run bot:start
scripts.bot:status: launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/com.travel-planner.discord-bot || echo "Travel Planner Discord bot LaunchAgent is not loaded. Run npm run bot:install after .env is ready."
scripts.bot:denied: grep discord-access-denied /tmp/travel-planner-discord-bot.err 2>/dev/null || echo "No discord-access-denied entries yet."
